--TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS

DECLARE @DATETOPROCESS DATE
SET @DATETOPROCESS = '2024-05-31'

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS_SELECT_SRC
(
                CURRENCY_CATEGORY,
                BILLER_NAME,
                BILLER_SERVICE_NAME,
                FCBS_BILLER_ID,
                FCBS_BILLER_SERVICE_ID,
                CHANNEL_BILLER_MNEM,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_OTC,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_ATM,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_EBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_MBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_PBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_CMS,
                WITH_SVC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_OTC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_ATM,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_EBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_MBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_IVRS,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_CMS,
                ALLOCATION_OTC_POSTING_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ATM_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_BILLER_BR,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                TRIM(CURRENCY_CATEGORY),
                TRIM(BILLER_NAME),
                TRIM(BILLER_SERVICE_NAME),
                TRIM(FCBS_BILLER_ID),
                TRIM(FCBS_BILLER_SERVICE_ID),
                TRIM(CHANNEL_BILLER_MNEM),
                TRIM(SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO),
                TRIM(AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_OTC),
                TRIM(AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_ATM),
                TRIM(AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_EBK),
                TRIM(AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_MBK),
                TRIM(AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_PBK),
                TRIM(AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_CMS),
                TRIM(WITH_SVC),
                SERVICE_CHARGE_OTC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_ATM,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_EBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_MBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_IVRS,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_CMS,
                ALLOCATION_OTC_POSTING_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ATM_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_BILLER_BR,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS_SELECT_SRC
(
                CURRENCY_CATEGORY,
                BILLER_NAME,
                BILLER_SERVICE_NAME,
                FCBS_BILLER_ID,
                FCBS_BILLER_SERVICE_ID,
                CHANNEL_BILLER_MNEM,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_OTC,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_ATM,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_EBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_MBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_PBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_CMS,
                WITH_SVC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_OTC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_ATM,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_EBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_MBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_IVRS,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_CMS,
                ALLOCATION_OTC_POSTING_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ATM_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_BILLER_BR,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.CURRENCY_CATEGORY,
                CC.BILLER_NAME,
                CC.BILLER_SERVICE_NAME,
                CC.FCBS_BILLER_ID,
                CC.FCBS_BILLER_SERVICE_ID,
                CC.CHANNEL_BILLER_MNEM,
                CC.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO,
                CC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_OTC,
                CC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_ATM,
                CC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_EBK,
                CC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_MBK,
                CC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_PBK,
                CC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_CMS,
                CC.WITH_SVC,
                CC.SERVICE_CHARGE_OTC,
                CC.SERVICE_CHARGE_ATM,
                CC.SERVICE_CHARGE_EBK,
                CC.SERVICE_CHARGE_MBK,
                CC.SERVICE_CHARGE_IVRS,
                CC.SERVICE_CHARGE_CMS,
                CC.ALLOCATION_OTC_POSTING_BR,
                CC.ALLOCATION_ATM_PAYOR_BR,
                CC.ALLOCATION_ATM_ATM_BR,
                CC.ALLOCATION_ATM_ACD,
                CC.ALLOCATION_ATM_BILLER_BR,
                CC.ALLOCATION_EBK_PAYOR_BR,
                CC.ALLOCATION_EBK_ACD,
                CC.ALLOCATION_EBK_BILLER_BR,
                CC.ALLOCATION_MBK_PAYOR_BR,
                CC.ALLOCATION_MBK_ACD,
                CC.ALLOCATION_MBK_BILLER_BR,
                CC.ALLOCATION_IVRS_PAYOR_BR,
                CC.ALLOCATION_IVRS_ACD,
                CC.ALLOCATION_IVRS_BILLER_BR,
                CC.ALLOCATION_CMS_PAYOR_BR,
                CC.ALLOCATION_CMS_BILLER_BR,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS CC
            JOIN [d360].[STG_EDS_DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS] B
            ON CC.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO = TRIM(B.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO)
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS_GROUP_SRC
(
                CURRENCY_CATEGORY,
                BILLER_NAME,
                BILLER_SERVICE_NAME,
                FCBS_BILLER_ID,
                FCBS_BILLER_SERVICE_ID,
                CHANNEL_BILLER_MNEM,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_OTC,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_ATM,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_EBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_MBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_PBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_CMS,
                WITH_SVC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_OTC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_ATM,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_EBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_MBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_IVRS,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_CMS,
                ALLOCATION_OTC_POSTING_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ATM_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_BILLER_BR,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                CURRENCY_CATEGORY,
                BILLER_NAME,
                BILLER_SERVICE_NAME,
                FCBS_BILLER_ID,
                FCBS_BILLER_SERVICE_ID,
                CHANNEL_BILLER_MNEM,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_OTC,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_ATM,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_EBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_MBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_PBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_CMS,
                WITH_SVC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_OTC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_ATM,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_EBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_MBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_IVRS,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_CMS,
                ALLOCATION_OTC_POSTING_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ATM_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_BILLER_BR,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                CURRENCY_CATEGORY,
                BILLER_NAME,
                BILLER_SERVICE_NAME,
                FCBS_BILLER_ID,
                FCBS_BILLER_SERVICE_ID,
                CHANNEL_BILLER_MNEM,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_OTC,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_ATM,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_EBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_MBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_PBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_CMS,
                WITH_SVC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_OTC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_ATM,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_EBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_MBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_IVRS,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_CMS,
                ALLOCATION_OTC_POSTING_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ATM_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_BILLER_BR,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                CURRENCY_CATEGORY,
                BILLER_NAME,
                BILLER_SERVICE_NAME,
                FCBS_BILLER_ID,
                FCBS_BILLER_SERVICE_ID,
                CHANNEL_BILLER_MNEM,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_OTC,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_ATM,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_EBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_MBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_PBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_CMS,
                WITH_SVC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_OTC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_ATM,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_EBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_MBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_IVRS,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_CMS,
                ALLOCATION_OTC_POSTING_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ATM_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_BILLER_BR
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS
(
                CURRENCY_CATEGORY,
                BILLER_NAME,
                BILLER_SERVICE_NAME,
                FCBS_BILLER_ID,
                FCBS_BILLER_SERVICE_ID,
                CHANNEL_BILLER_MNEM,
                SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_OTC,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_ATM,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_EBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_MBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_PBK,
                AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_CMS,
                WITH_SVC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_OTC,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_ATM,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_EBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_MBK,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_IVRS,
                SERVICE_CHARGE_CMS,
                ALLOCATION_OTC_POSTING_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ATM_BR,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_ATM_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_EBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_MBK_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_ACD,
                ALLOCATION_IVRS_BILLER_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_PAYOR_BR,
                ALLOCATION_CMS_BILLER_BR,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                SRC.CURRENCY_CATEGORY,
                SRC.BILLER_NAME,
                SRC.BILLER_SERVICE_NAME,
                SRC.FCBS_BILLER_ID,
                SRC.FCBS_BILLER_SERVICE_ID,
                SRC.CHANNEL_BILLER_MNEM,
                SRC.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NO,
                SRC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_OTC,
                SRC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_ATM,
                SRC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_EBK,
                SRC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_MBK,
                SRC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_PBK,
                SRC.AVAILABLE_CHANNELS_CMS,
                SRC.WITH_SVC,
                SRC.SERVICE_CHARGE_OTC,
                SRC.SERVICE_CHARGE_ATM,
                SRC.SERVICE_CHARGE_EBK,
                SRC.SERVICE_CHARGE_MBK,
                SRC.SERVICE_CHARGE_IVRS,
                SRC.SERVICE_CHARGE_CMS,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_OTC_POSTING_BR,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_ATM_PAYOR_BR,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_ATM_ATM_BR,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_ATM_ACD,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_ATM_BILLER_BR,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_EBK_PAYOR_BR,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_EBK_ACD,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_EBK_BILLER_BR,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_MBK_PAYOR_BR,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_MBK_ACD,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_MBK_BILLER_BR,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_IVRS_PAYOR_BR,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_IVRS_ACD,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_IVRS_BILLER_BR,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_CMS_PAYOR_BR,
                SRC.ALLOCATION_CMS_BILLER_BR,
				@DATETOPROCESS,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5),
				'DID',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_PROPRIETARYBILLERS_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
